s.note: Tick Tock McGlaughlin calling the races on the radio
s.how: Toss 400g raw unsalted peanuts with 30g melted butter, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until deep golden. Cool for 10 minutes so the coating crisps, then serve in paper bags.

s.n: Seabiscuit's apple and cheddar hand pies
s.how: Cook 3 peeled diced apples with 30g butter, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 6 minutes until soft, then cool. Cut 8 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry. Put a spoon of apple and a few cubes of cheddar from 100g on each, fold over and crimp with a fork. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sugar and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden.

m.note: the match race against War Admiral at Pimlico
m.how: Mix 500g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp celery salt, 1/2 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and 60g panko. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side. Bake 800g frozen chips and toss with paprika salt. Toss shredded cabbage with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and vinegar. Serve with lemon wedges.

w.how: Peel and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and toss with 80g caster sugar, 2 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp cornflour. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and fill. Rub 60g butter into 80g plain flour and 60g brown sugar and scatter over the top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes until golden and bubbling. Cool 20 minutes and serve with ice cream.

d.note: George Woolf, the jockey they called the Iceman
d.how: Steep 5 black tea bags in 800ml boiling water with 3 tbsp honey and strips of peel from 1 orange for 5 minutes. Remove the bags and peel, then chill for 1 hour. Stir in the juice of 3 oranges. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour over the tea and garnish with orange slices and mint.
